description: Get the AS4 delivery details a sender needs for one specific document type: transport profile, receiving endpoint URL, process identifier, and the service activation/expiration window. Call lookup_participant first to get the exact documentTypeId to pass here. An expired ServiceExpirationDate means the participant is listed but that document type is no longer deliverable.

documentTypeId.description: Full document type identifier value exactly as lookup_participant returned it in documentTypes[].value, e.g. "urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:Invoice-2::Invoice##urn:cen.eu:en16931:2017#compliant#urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:3.0::2.1".

name: get_participant_endpoint
title: Get Participant Endpoint
